topic.title: Project Settings and Members
topic.shortdesc: Project owners use project settings to inspect project configuration and use project members management to control access in private projects.

body.p: Project administration includes both configuration details and access control. Project owners may need to review project settings, manage repository connection details, or control who can access a private project.

section.title: Project Settings
section.p: The project settings area shows the main project configuration, such as repository connection details and other project information. This information is available to all project members.

section.title: Project Members
section.p: For private projects, the project owners can manage the list of project members. This helps control who can access the project and participate in the work.

section.title: Why it Matters
section.p: Project settings and member management help authors keep the project connected, controlled, and ready for collaboration.
